uncited: It solves the bottleneck of rendering millions of 3D Gaussians on general-purpose GPUs by offloading specific geometric operations to fixed-function hardware.

It differs from general compute-pipeline approaches by isolating preprocessing (point-based) from rendering (tile-based) into a four-stage pipeline, and from sibling methods like [Speedy-Splat Rendering Pipeline](3543-speedy-splat-rendering-pipeline.md) by its specific focus on dedicated silicon units for projection and sorting rather than purely algorithmic software optimizations.
*   **Input:** 3D Gaussian parameters (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics coefficients) and camera matrices.
The concept of hardware-accelerated Gaussian rasterization emerged as a response to the high computational cost of rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting on general-purpose GPUs.
